dialogue.text: Watchman PellWatchman. Night shift. It is presently day, which is why I'm holding a wick-knife and a grudge.
VesperHow many lamps?Quiet nights?Carry on, watchman.
Watchman PellTwo hundred and six, counting the strings over the water. I don't count those out loud.
VesperHow many lamps?Quiet nights?Carry on, watchman.
Watchman PellQuiet enough. Gulls arguing, water working, somebody laughing at the cookhouse too late.
